title: Cassius
summary: Raleigh names Cassius in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Cassius, who first took Tarichea and carried 3000 Iewes captive. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VII, §. VI, sig. 228b
